## Acceptance Criteria

### Agent

## Go/No-Go Criteria

**GO if:** the problem is real, measured, and a bounded build slice can fix it without widening any gate beyond what the evidence supports today.
**NO-GO if:** the problem is an artefact of measurement.

## Recommendation

**Recommendation:** GO
**Rationale:** The Recommendation and Decision sections are filled on every inception, research or not. They are long, they read like analysis, and a predicate that counted them would declare universal coverage. This fixture exists so that never happens silently: all of this prose is here and none of it may count.
